evals.name: bond-market-tipping-point
evals.prompt: I keep seeing headlines about bond yields but honestly I don't get it. Can you turn this video into an HTML explainer page with diagrams so I can understand it without watching it? https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JFTeh7lZ9Cw
evals.expected_output: A single self-contained HTML file explaining the TLDR News video on why a 5.25% 10-year Treasury yield is the bond market's tipping point: the bond price/yield relationship, the stock-bond relationship, the historical evidence, and today's situation, with several pure-CSS diagrams (e.g. seesaw for price vs yield, threshold scale, timeline of past episodes, cause-effect flow). Few or no screenshots because the video's motion graphics can be rebuilt as diagrams.
assertions: Produces exactly one HTML page
Page is self-contained (images inlined, no external scripts/styles/images)
Diagrams are pure HTML+CSS (no <svg>, <canvas> or <script>)
Contains at least 4 diagrams
Has at least 3 timestamp deep links into the video
No horizontal overflow or broken images at 400px phone width
Uses at most 2 screenshots (motion-graphics news video: diagrams should carry it)
States the 5.25% threshold
Explains price vs yield with the video's $1,000 bond sold at $900 (~5.5%) example
Explains the normal inverse stock-bond relationship and its flip past the threshold
Covers the doom-loop risk (stocks = 33% of household wealth)
Leaves out the sponsor segment (Proton Mail)

evals.name: ai-animation-workflow
evals.prompt: Make me a visual explainer page for this video, I want to understand the workflow they used: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=evK-Y83Qlco
evals.expected_output: A single self-contained HTML file explaining the 'Crazy AI Animation Workflow - Opus 5.5' video: the three attempts (Blender primitives from code, Tripo model + keyframed walk, AI-generated video copied onto a skeleton), the final pipeline as a CSS flow diagram, numbers like 29 bones / 97 frames / ~30 min per clip, and screenshots of the visual results (the animated animals, side-by-side comparison) because the results are visual and can't be shown as CSS diagrams.
assertions: Produces exactly one HTML page
Page is self-contained (images inlined, no external scripts/styles/images)
Diagrams are pure HTML+CSS (no <svg>, <canvas> or <script>)
Contains at least 4 diagrams
Has at least 3 timestamp deep links into the video
No horizontal overflow or broken images at 400px phone width
Includes at least 2 screenshots of the visual results (demo video)
Covers all three attempts (Blender from code, Tripo + keyframes, AI video copied to bones)
Includes the key numbers (29 bones, 97 frames, ~30 min per clip)
Explains why it fails on people (a video has no depth)
Explains the animal 'brain' (two circles: watch, then flee)
